title: What Should a Manual Handling Risk Assessment Cover?
seoTitle: Manual Handling Risk Assessment: What to Cover | Fit2Trade
description: A practical Great Britain guide to manual handling risk assessments: what to observe, record and change, and when to use HSE's MAC, RAPP, ART or V-MAC tools.
excerpt: A useful manual handling assessment starts by asking whether the task can be avoided, then examines the real task, load, people and environment before assigning controls and review triggers.
author: Fit2Trade
